d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how high-stakes diplomatic talks in Dakar have laid bare a permanent geopolitical shift in West Africa. Twenty-one months after Burkina Faso, Mali, and Niger walked away from ECOWAS, the Alliance of Sahel States (AES) has officially ruled out any possibility of rejoining the regional bloc. While high-level discussions between the two sides opened a channel to preserve vital cross-border trade, landlocked supply routes, and joint counter-terrorism efforts against JNIM and Islamic State Sahel, the Sahel leaders firmly insist on operating strictly as two…
